question: The sides of two squares are in the ratio 4 : 3 and the sum of their areas is 225 cm². Find the perimeter of the smaller square (in cm).
solution:
**Given:**

The sides of two squares [(S₁) and (S₂)] are in the ratio 4 : 3 

The sum of their Areas is 225 cm².

**Formula used:**

The Perimeter (P) of the smaller square = 4 (side) 

Area of a Square = (side)²

**Calculations:**

According to the question,

S₁/S₂ = 4/3

⇒ S₁ = 4(S₂)/3, and

Then Areas of the Square:

(S₁)² + (S₂)² = 225

⇒ (4S₂/3)² + (S₂)² = 225

⇒ 16(S₂)²/9 + (S₂)² = 225

⇒ 25 (S₂)²/9 = 225

⇒ 25 (S₂)² = 2025

⇒ (S2)2 = 2025/25

⇒ (S2)2 = 81 = 9 cm

⇒ S₁ = (4 × 9)/3

⇒ S₁ = 36/3 = 12 cm

The perimeter of the smaller square:

⇒ P = 4 × 9 = 36 cm

**∴ The perimeter of the smaller square will be 36 cm.**
